  • Constructor Details

    • ChangePoint

      ChangePoint(String tag, int index, double time, int detectionIndex, int direction)
      Creates a change point.
      Parameters:
      tag - measured tag
      index - estimated row index where the shift started
      time - time stamp of that row
      detectionIndex - row index at which the CUSUM crossed the threshold
      direction - +1 for an upward shift of the residual, -1 for a downward shift
